description: Election Commission - R. Y. G. N. Wimalasena was selected as the member of the Yatinuwara P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and local authority member appointments, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
